# routeros_system_ptp (Resource)
Manage `/system/ptp`. Requires RouterOS 7.25.1 or later and the corresponding hardware/package. [CLI reference](https://manual.mikrotik.com/docs/7.25/cli-reference/system/ptp/).

## Example Usage
```terraform
# RouterOS 7.25.1+. Check the menu's package and hardware requirements.
resource "routeros_system_ptp" "example" {
  name      = "site-clock"
  ptp_mode  = "transparent-clock"
  transport = "l2-forwardable"
  disabled  = true
}
```
